releases.name: v0.21.1 — AGY review in Herdr.app
releases.body:
`/annotate` and `/annotate <local-document>` now work in Herdr.app for AGY panes and sub-agents without starting the model. Annotate uses a floating peek when Herdr identifies the focused caller, and otherwise opens a reviewer pane in the caller's or host's tab without switching focus. If opening fails, AGY shows the reason and ends the turn.

Explicit Send returns notes to the same AGY conversation, and reply review skips prior `/annotate` turns. Browser protocol remains 11. Herdr.app 0.1.18 does not reliably identify a shown or peeked sub-agent, so those cases may open in the host tab.

## Install or update

```sh
# First install
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

For an AGY installation managed through npm, run `npm install -g @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest` and keep the hooks and skill linked to that installation. See [AGY setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.21.1/README.md#antigravity-agy-support) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1).

releases.name: v0.21.0 — Chrome companion setup and updates
releases.body:
- When the Chrome companion is missing or disabled, web reviews from OpenCode
  and AGY show setup steps, copy the unpacked folder path, and reveal it in Finder.
- An idle unpacked companion reloads automatically when its manifest version
  increases. If a review is in progress, finish it and use **Reload Annotate**.
- When upgrading from a version without automatic reload, use **Reload Annotate**
  once to load browser protocol 11 and enable automatic updates.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

See [Chrome companion setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.21.0/README.md#chrome-direct-delivery) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.20.1...v0.21.0).

releases.name: v0.20.1 — Send AGY notes on quit
releases.body:
- In AGY reviews, press `q` to send pending notes and close, just as in OpenCode. With no notes, `q` just closes. `Ctrl+C` still closes without sending.
- A successful `/annotate` interception adds a status line to clear AGY’s stuck `Working…` indicator without starting a model turn.
- Model-invoked reviews open beside an unfocused AGY pane without stealing focus. Declined slash interceptions and popup outcomes are recorded in `~/.local/share/opencode-annotate/agy-review.log`.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

See the [AGY and Herdr setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.20.1/README.md#antigravity-agy-support) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.20.0...v0.20.1).

releases.name: v0.20.0 — AGY reviews in Herdr
releases.body:
- In a configured Herdr AGY pane, `/annotate` and `prefix+a` open the native reviewer without starting a model turn. **Send** returns notes to the originating conversation; `q` and `Ctrl+C` do not send.
- Configured Kitty toolbar images render at full size in Herdr.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

See the [AGY and Herdr setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.20.0/README.md#antigravity-agy-support) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.19.0...v0.20.0).

releases.name: v0.19.0 — Annotate files
releases.body:
- Choose **Annotate a file (TUI)** or run `/annotate-file [query]` to find text and config files in the current session's directory using OpenCode's `@` file search.
- You can also pass a supported file path directly to `/annotate`. Non-Markdown files display as code blocks to preserve formatting. `.env` and credential-looking filenames are excluded.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.18.0...v0.19.0)
